claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_parameter_override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items can grant a named spell but constrain or override part of that spell's authored payload. The current surface can override DC and targeting only; it cannot narrow a granted spell's allowed command mode or replace the spell's printed area shape/range header.
